name: AECi — Linear reconciliation sweep not running (no backlog gauge)
message:
The request→Linear reconciliation sweep has emitted no `aeci.linear.reconcile.stuck` backlog gauge for ~1h (AECI-219 / Phase 6.12). The sweep runs every 15 min (`*/15 * * * *`, staging + production) and emits the gauge on EVERY run — 0 on a clean run — so the always-emitted point doubles as the sweep-liveness heartbeat (the same always-reports pattern as the Algolia index-drift gauge and the moderation-queue snapshot). No point for ~1h (≈4 missed sweeps + grace) means the sweep itself stalled — the ADR-0013 cron→queue→consumer (`apps/api/src/scheduled.ts` → `aeci-reconcile-{staging,production}` → `lib/reconciliation-sweep.ts`) is not running — so stuck `open`/`linear_issue_id=null` requests are NO LONGER being retried, and the §6.2 backstop is down. Check the API Worker's scheduled invocations / `wrangler tail`, confirm the `*/15 * * * *` trigger is present in `apps/api/wrangler.jsonc` and the `aeci-reconcile-<env>` queue + consumer exist.

Note: this is the LIVENESS companion to `AECi — Linear reconciliation: persistent stuck requests` (which alerts on the `aeci.linear.reconcile.persistent_failure` failure signal). The split mirrors the Algolia 'sync failed' + 'sync not running' pair: keep the failure and liveness concerns on separate monitors. The `< 0` threshold is intentionally UNSATISFIABLE — the backlog gauge is always ≥ 0, so the value-threshold never fires; this monitor's only job is `notify_no_data`. The backlog VALUE (a real stuck backlog) is alerted by the persistent-failure monitor, not here. The ~1h no_data_timeframe is launch-tunable alongside the 15-min sweep cadence (constants in `lib/reconciliation-sweep.ts`).

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#linear-reconciliation--stuck-requests
